title: Warranty Coverage Parts Desk Terms: Shipping Times, Shipping Fees and Replacement Matching
content:
Where Ridgeline Warranty Coverage remedies a claim by sending covered parts to the customer, these terms set how soon the parts ship, the fee per shipment, and how a replacement part is matched.

| Plan | Parts ship within (business days after a parts-only approval) | Shipping fee per shipment (USD) | Discontinued part replaced by nearest current-production equivalent | Finish color matching on replacement parts |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | 10 | 24.95 | yes | nearest current production |
| Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty | 10 | 24.95 | yes | nearest current production |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | 7 | 19.95 | yes | nearest current production |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty | 7 | 0.00 | yes | nearest current production |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty | 5 | 0.00 | yes | nearest current production |
| Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty | 5 | 0.00 | yes | nearest current production |

## Terms

- **Shipping time** — business days after a parts-only approval within which the parts ship.
- **Shipping fee** — charged per shipment of covered parts sent to the customer for a parts-only remedy; 0.00 means the plan ships at no fee.
- **Discontinued parts** — in every plan a discontinued part is replaced with the nearest current-production equivalent rather than an exact match.
- **Color** — finish color on a replacement part is matched to the nearest current production color.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

Two separate shipments of covered parts under the Ridgeline Limited Warranty carry the shipping fee once each, 24.95 per shipment; under the Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty the same two shipments carry no fee.
